props.description:
Content to be rendered inside the SummaryStats component.
Composed of SummaryStats.Item subcomponents.
props.title: children

props.description:
Layout variant for the stats container.
- "horizontal": Items in a single row (2-6 items recommended).
- "grid": Items in a 2-column grid layout (2 or 4 items recommended).
props.title: layout

props.description:
Enables expandable mode where stats can be clicked to show additional content.
This is the default for every SummaryStats.Item; an item can override it with
its own `expandable` prop. Ignored in the "grid" layout.
props.title: expandable

props.description:
The id of the currently active stat (controlled mode).
When provided, the component becomes controlled and `onActiveStatIdChange`
should be used to handle state changes. Pass `null` for no active stat.
props.title: activeStatId

props.description:
Callback fired when the user toggles a stat, in both controlled and
uncontrolled modes. Receives the new active stat id, or `null` when the
active stat is deselected. It is not fired when the active stat unmounts,
loses its children, or becomes static.
props.title: onActiveStatIdChange

props.description: Brief text that identifies the metric.
props.title: description

props.description:
Whether this stat is expandable (interactive). When unset, the stat
inherits the `expandable` value of the SummaryStats container. An explicit
`true` or `false` overrides the container value. Ignored in the "grid"
layout. Set it to `false` on stats without children so they stay static.
props.title: expandable

props.description: Trend indicator showing the change direction.
props.title: trend

props.description: Text describing the trend or change (e.g., "+15%", "-5%", "0%").
props.title: trendText

props.description: Tooltip content for the info icon. If provided, displays an info icon.
props.title: infoTooltip

props.description:
Content to display when this stat is active (for expandable variant).
This content will be rendered in the expandable area below the stats row.
props.title: children
